# ClawHub API Context

The ClawHub API is versioned under `https://clawhub.ai/api/v1`.

## Discovery

- OpenAPI: https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/openapi.json
- API docs: https://clawhub.ai/docs/api
- API catalog: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/api-catalog
- OAuth authorization server metadata: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- OAuth protected resource metadata: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

## Authentication

Public read endpoints do not require authentication. Protected write endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer clh_...`.

## Rate Limits

API responses expose `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, and `RateLimit-Reset` headers so agents can self-throttle.

## Recommended Agent Flow

1. Fetch the OpenAPI description.
2. Use public read endpoints for search and inspection.
3. Request or reuse a ClawHub API token before publishing, changing ownership, or calling moderation/account endpoints.
4. Honor rate-limit and retry headers.
